noteImageStorageModeEncryptedDbDesc: Images are stored as encrypted fields inside the notes database, with the same protection as note text. Best security; a large photo library makes the database file bigger.
noteImageStorageModeDiskPlainDesc: Images are saved as ordinary, unencrypted files on disk (same approach as the clipboard module), with only a path recorded in the database. Faster and keeps the database smaller, but the image files themselves aren't encrypted.
noteTextStorageModeEncryptedDbDesc: Note text is stored inside the encrypted notes database, with the best security - this is today's existing behavior.
noteTextStorageModeDiskPlainDesc: Note text is saved as an ordinary plain .txt file on disk, with only a path recorded in the database. Anyone outside the vault can open that file directly - it isn't encrypted.
